scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Validates that the hero section displays correctly with product tagline, value proposition, and visual elements as specified in REQ-1 and US-1

steps.description: Navigate to the homepage route (/) and render the complete page
steps.context: User lands on homepage as new visitor

steps.description: Check that hero section contains headline, subheadline, and CTAs within the viewport
steps.context: Hero section should be immediately visible without scrolling

steps.context: Background effect should enhance visual appeal without affecting readability

test_cases.expected: Headline text about URL shortening service is visible
Subheadline mentions analytics capabilities
Primary CTA button 'Get Started' is visible
Secondary CTA button 'Learn More' is visible
BackgroundEffect component is rendered and visible

Click Tracking feature card is displayed with icon and description

scenarios.name: How It Works Section
scenarios.description: Validates the 3-step process explanation section as specified in REQ-5 and US-4

steps.action: Navigate to How It Works section
steps.description: Scroll down to the How It Works section
steps.context: Section should be below features section

steps.description: Check that all three steps are displayed with numbers, titles, and descriptions
steps.context: Steps should explain: Paste URL, Get short link, Track clicks

steps.description: Confirm steps are presented in logical visual flow
steps.context: Numbers should be clearly visible and steps connected visually

test_cases.expected: Step 1 displays 'Paste your long URL' with number 1
Step 2 displays 'Get your short link instantly' with number 2
Step 3 displays 'Track clicks and analyze performance' with number 3
All three steps have visible step numbers
Steps displayed in horizontal flow
Steps displayed in vertical flow
